title: The support of τ(M, θ, ξ) lies in every closed set containing M (parent step 4; Simon 6.2.11–2.12)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let Y ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be a current in ℝ^P (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n) representing Y, i.e. Y(ω) = R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P). If F ⊆ ℝ^P is closed and M ⊆ F (R.carrier ⊆ F), then spt Y ⊆ F. Here spt Y = Y.support is Simon's support (6.2.11): ℝ^P minus the union of the relatively compact open sets W on which Y vanishes, i.e. Y(ω) = 0 whenever spt ω ⊆ W.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (F : Set (Euclid P)), R.Represents Y → IsClosed F → R.carrier ⊆ F → Y.support ⊆ F
